purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/singer-hd6600c.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: The standalone machine page redirects to the homepage (likely discontinued as a standalone); this live bundle page lists the 6600C
Technical specification on printed p.31; metric only
Lists 6600C Heavy Duty under Limited 25/1 Year

facts.value: Maximum 1000 +/- 50 rpm with straight stitch at default length (manual); Singer's Canada page excerpt says up to 1100
facts.note: Maker documents disagree with each other; the manual figure is the technical spec.

site.label: Speed
site.juki: Manual: 1000 +/- 50 stitches per minute. A Singer Canada page excerpt says up to 1,100.

facts.value: 215 stitch applications; no separate stitch count published
facts.note: Our 100 built-in stitches has no maker source in the documents read. Singer's 215 is an applications count, not stitches.

site.label: Stitches
site.juki: Singer advertises 215 stitch applications and publishes no separate stitch count.

facts.spec_value: 1-step automatic buttonhole; number of styles not consistent across sources
facts.note: Singer states 6 styles, which settles the inconsistency.

facts.value: 6.4 in throat space (bundle copy only; not in the manual's spec table)
facts.note: Singer's wording is 'throat space'; whether that is needle to body (rule 11) is not stated.

site.label: Throat space
site.juki: 6.4 in, Singer's wording on the bundle page.
site.others: Not in the manual's specification table.

facts.value: about 440 L x 190 W x 280 H mm = 17.3 x 7.5 x 11.0 in (manual)
facts.spec_value: 17.3 x 7.5 x 10.9 (listed as depth x width x height by the parts dealer)

facts.value: Manual lists a manual thread knife for trimming ends; no automatic cutter published
facts.spec_value: None; the automatic thread cutter is listed as a 6800C exclusive

facts.value: All-purpose, zipper, buttonhole, blind hem and satin stitch feet; 4 class 15 bobbins and accessories
facts.note: Bundle includes accessories worth $100 per Singer.

facts.value: Wattage and amperage not published; manual lists rated voltage only
facts.spec_value: Singer describes the motor as 60 percent stronger; wattage not published

facts.value: Listed under Limited 25/1 Year Warranty as 6600C Heavy Duty
facts.spec_value: 25 yr limited on machine head; electrical 2 yr on Singer's page, 1 yr on retailer copy; 90 days on adjustments etc.
facts.note: Singer's warranty page places the 6600C under 25/1, so the '2 yr electrical' line in our spec does not match; the component split is in a PDF not fetched.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: Limited 25/1 Year Warranty per Singer's coverage page.
site.others: Some dealer copy says 2 years electrical.

facts.value: MSRP $448.98 for the extension-table bundle, shown at $319.99 on 2026-10-01
facts.note: Singer's strike-through MSRP is a comparison price, not a selling price.

facts.value: motor 60% stronger than a standard machine motor; full metal frame; powerful motor delivers high-speed, heavy-duty sewing
